entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay,
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant.
Issue notice to the respondent returnable on 17th December 2019.
Learned A.P.P. waives service of notice for the respondents.

2. Till next date, in the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with Crime No.0538/2019,
registered at Nanded Gramin Police Station for the ofence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273,
328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26, 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a), 59(IV) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees ffteen thousand) with one surety in the like amount.
3. The applicant shall attend the concerned police station as and when directed by the investigating ofcer.

(R.G. AVACHAT) JUDGE fmp/-
